content.question: What is an imbalanced dataset in a classification problem?
options: A dataset in which one class has significantly fewer samples than the other class(es).
A dataset that contains too many features relative to the number of samples.
A dataset where most feature values are missing or inconsistent.
A dataset in which all classes have exactly the same number of samples.
content.answer: A dataset in which one class has significantly fewer samples than the other class(es).
